config.stop_rule: At most two four-game adaptation rounds, with independent Stockfish review and a network update after each game. Stop this pilot after the fixed fresh evaluation regardless of wins; report whether the target was reached.
config.consistency_criterion: A lower 95% Wilson bound on the fraction of outright wins above 0.5, separately at each nominal engine setting in the fixed fresh evaluation. This does not establish a human/site Elo.
config.promotion: Fresh colour-pair bootstrap 95% lower score bound above 0.5 versus the current preserved best, at least 0.5 score versus the matched teacher-only ablation, and no candidate reliability failure. Otherwise retain the preserved best.
config.data_scope: 21 unique legal cases from the supplied Markdown; the referenced 1862-game companion corpus is unavailable unless explicitly added and audited in a new configuration. Cases are training-only. Use existing train-only Carlsen/Witty, puzzle and phase replay.

games.host_load_scope: Host-wide average during game and initialization; includes all applications, not per-engine utilization or an isolated-core guarantee.
